items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color Picker
items.description: Composable color picker for shadcn/ui (Base UI): a saturation/brightness area plus Hue, Saturation, Lightness and optional Alpha bars that preview the color at every step.

items.name: image-cropper
items.title: Image Cropper
items.description: Avatar / icon image cropper for shadcn/ui (Base UI): drag, pinch, wheel and keyboard pan/zoom, 90° rotation, circle or square cutout, square output. Animated GIFs are re-encoded as animated WebP. Includes an inline ImageCropper and a ready-made ImageCropperDialog.

items.name: emotive-avatar
items.title: Emotive Avatar
items.description: Two-tone, eyes-only animated avatar (Grok Bot / OpenAI dots style) on a single canvas: 20 emotions, mood blending, gestures, loops, talking, autonomous behaviour and eyes that wrap round a 3D head. Includes a crowd of drifting dots and an <emotive-avatar> custom element. No dependencies.
